sections.heading: Overview
sections.markdown: **Consumed by T-GLOBAL-SMFG-003 (2026-10-19 WEEKLY_DEEP) -> KILL (valuation).** Draft -> Drew attack -> Revision (recurring ROE 8.6% ex ~JPY224bn one-offs, target 18.78, entry 17.75) -> re-attack confirmed -> Aldrich KILL. At 17.75 the win state is +11.10%/3y against a 12.10% hurdle, so even p_up = 1.0 fails; the entry that clears (~12.97-13.93) sits below the 14.20 kill. The 2026-10-16 FY2026 ROE 10.0% print does not survive the recurring correction, so this is the second valuation kill (002 was the first) and LESSON-0002 is satisfied rather than tripped. **Re-advance condition:** only a materially lower entry (~13.90, ~0.89x book) with the warranted multiple re-evidenced, or hard evidence that recurring ROE is >=9% without one-offs — not the same numbers at a lower price.

sections.heading: SMFG — Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group
sections.markdown:
**RE-AFFIRMED WATCH (2026-09-28 IDEATION).** Card at the 21-day boundary; SMFG re-screens #9 GLOBAL MOMENTUM ($26.61, −3.5% off the 52w high, mom12 +50.2%) — first re-entry since the 09-03 stamp. Re-advance conditions unchanged and unmet: no Q1-FY26 ROE evidence (dossier refresh still pending, dyport ROE basis predates the 07-31 print) and P/BV at the 52w high still ≥ the ~1.4x warrant. Sleeve re-entry alone does not re-advance — same call as 09-03. Stamped a further 21 days; Saturday may pick it up on ROE evidence.

**RE-STAMPED WATCH (2026-09-03 IDEATION).** Screen signal restored: SMFG re-entered the GLOBAL MOMENTUM sleeve today at #5 (mom12 +53.8%, $26.72, at the 52-wk high). Re-advance conditions remain unmet — dossier ROE 6.87% (FY25, asof 07-22, predates the 07-31 Q1-FY26 print) and P/BV at the 52-wk high sits above the ~1.4x warrant, i.e. the price has run up to/through the warranted multiple the 08-06 Bear derived (1.36x), not back to a discounted entry. Sleeve oscillation does not itself change the verdict; re-advance only on Q1-FY26 ROE > 9% evidence (dossier refresh needed) or P/BV ≤ ~1.4x.

**RE-AFFIRMED WATCH (2026-08-27 IDEATION).** Card at the 21-day re-affirmation boundary; screen signal now invalidated — SMFG has dropped off the GLOBAL MOMENTUM screen (was #10 on 08-06; absent from the 12-name sleeve today). The WATCH persists off-screen by design: re-advance conditions unchanged (ROE > 9% evidence or P/BV ≤ ~1.4x). No new evidence; prior decision honored. Would re-advance only on a deep-dive proving the warranted multiple, not a lower price.

**RE-STAMPED ADVANCE→WATCH (2026-08-06).** T-GLOBAL-SMFG-002 (advanced from this card 08-05) was KILLED by the full CONSTRUCT gauntlet: Bear dispositive — on delivered ROE 9%, warranted P/BV 1.36x vs market ~1.6-1.7x; analyst conceded all 9 points, ev_math revised to −13.5%. The card's "back at prior entry math = cheap" premise was falsified, not reaffirmed. Price has since fallen to $22.42 (MOMENTUM #10), nearer the warranted multiple, but the onus for a re-advance is a deep-dive showing ROE > 9% evidence or P/BV ≤ ~1.4x — not just a lower price. Re-advance on that, else it stays WATCH under the 11 untouched ADVANCE cards.

**Signal / why now (original, 08-04):** SMFG is the session's recorded highest-priority kill-revisit: killed 07-13 on a process/tooling artifact rather than merits (per 07-22 journal), now at $25.88 vs $25.74 entry — back at the prior entry math — with a freshly QC-verified dossier. It screens #9 GLOBAL MOMENTUM (mom12 +57%), and BOJ normalization (the only G7 central bank hiking) is a direct NIM tailwind on the ¥101T domestic loan book, aligned WITH the desk's rate-divergence regime.

**Archetype:** quality_bank_rerating (rate 0.48, up +42%, down -20%, 3y). Method card: VAL_FINANCIALS_BANK. EV = +9.76%.

**3 questions a deep-dive must answer:**
1. What is SMFG's NIM sensitivity per 25bp BOJ hike, and how much of the path is already priced at P/BV ~1.4x (vs ~0.5-0.6x pre-re-rate)?
2. Is the 07-13 process kill fully explained as a tooling artifact — do any residual stage-log/data anomalies survive re-inspection?
3. Does the ~3.5% total shareholder-return yield (dividend + buyback) anchor the downside through a BOJ pause, and what is overseas-book credit risk through a Fed-on-hold cycle?

**Fast-disqualify:** EV positive ✓ (+9.76%). Valuation target P/BV-anchored to ROE through the rate path — plausibly clears entry on the base-rate up-leg ✓. Primary sources (BOJ statements, SMFG filings, dossier) reachable ✓.


**PROMOTED 2026-10-19 (WEEKLY_DEEP)** — consumed as the GLOBAL deep-dive; advanced to construction chain T-GLOBAL-SMFG-003. Re-advance gate met on the refreshed 2026-10-16 dossier: FY2026 ROE 10.0% > 9% (net income JPY 1,583bn / equity JPY 15,786bn), with Q1 FY3/27 (quarter to 2026-06, the post-07-31 print) net income JPY 501.4bn; the prior WATCH required that Q1 ROE evidence or P/BV <= ~1.4x. The chain must test the warranted P/BV against delivered ROE through the BOJ path, the overseas-book credit risk, and whether the ~3.5% total shareholder yield anchors downside.
